answer: You can request a refund by contacting customer support with your order number and reason for the refund. Refund processing usually depends on the payment method.

questions: How can I return my order?

answer: You can request a return within the allowed return period. Please provide your order number and the reason for the return.

questions: What payment methods do you accept?
How can I pay for my order?
answer: We accept common payment methods such as credit cards, debit cards, and supported online payment options.
If your payment failed, please check your card details, available balance, and internet connection. You can also try another supported payment method.

questions: How many days does delivery take?
When can I expect my package?
answer: Standard shipping usually takes a few business days. Delivery time can vary depending on your location and the shipping method selected.

questions: Do I have to pay for shipping?
answer: Shipping charges depend on your location, order size, and selected delivery method. Any applicable shipping fee will be shown during checkout.

questions: What should I do if my product is damaged?
answer: We're sorry that your product arrived damaged. Please contact customer support with your order number and photos of the damaged item so we can assist you.

questions: You sent me the wrong product

answer: We're sorry about the incorrect item. Please provide your order number and details of the product you received so we can help resolve the issue.

questions: How do I create an account?

answer: You can create an account by selecting the Sign Up or Register option and entering your required information.

questions: How can I reset my password?
How do I change my password?
answer: You can reset your password by selecting 'Forgot Password' on the login page and following the instructions sent to your registered email.
